comment: Sample management profile with internal API/Control UI auth (SQLite users + JWT). For .deb/.rpm installs, sqlite_path matches the packaged data directory (/usr/local/gossipper/data). For local dev you may use e.g. ./data/gossipper-settings.sqlite. Copy, set jwt_secret, run gossipper auth user-add, then point server -config at this file. NOTE: starting with the admin console, the jwt_secret in this file is only used as the *initial* bootstrap value — once the server persists it (or you call POST /api/v2/settings/rotate-jwt-secret from the UI), the secret stored in the SQLite kv_settings table takes precedence on subsequent restarts. To force a rotation, either click 'Rotate now' in Settings or delete the row WHERE key='jwt_secret' from kv_settings. ui_data_dir enables the /api/v2/* admin-console REST surface on api_addr (profiles / scenarios / media / jobs live under that directory); when set, legacy /api/v1/* is auto-disabled — pass "legacy_api_v1": true here to keep both APIs. scenario_history_keep limits how many prior scenario XML revisions are kept per id when a scenario is updated via the UI (0 = unlimited).
